E0751

`Panic` can't be granted, only denied

What

`Panic` can't be granted, only denied

Why

`Panic` is a deny-only effect row; no positive effect bound or authority can grant it

Fix

Drop `Panic` from the list, or write `-[!Panic]>`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0751: tests/ui/panic_effect_grant.stderr.
